normalizations.name: URI
normalizations.reason: trim trailing whitespace in normative XML

relations.name: IsCapableToPerform
relations.note: Conditional client/supplier combinations in the normative IsCapableOfPerforming constraints; ProjectActivity is explicitly excluded from the general ResourcePerformer branch.

relations.name: PerformsInContext
relations.note: Conditional role/action pairings from the normative client and supplier constraints.

relations.name: Implements
relations.note: Client (implementation) points to supplier (specification). Cross-domain combinations are checked as pairs, never as an unconstrained Cartesian product.

relations.name: CapabilityGeneralization
relations.origin: UML Generalization adapter named in NATO guideline C1
relations.note: Specific capability points to generic capability; this is not a native stereotype in the UAFP XML.

relations.name: CapabilityDependency
relations.origin: NATO guideline C3 CapabilityDependency DMM tuple adapter
relations.note: Dependent capability points to independent capability. Not a native stereotype in the UAFP XML.

relations.name: ServiceGeneralization
relations.origin: UML Generalization adapter for NATO guideline S1
relations.note: Specific service specification points to generic service specification.

relations.name: OperationalGeneralization
relations.origin: UML Generalization adapter for NATO guideline L1

relations.name: ResourceGeneralization
relations.origin: UML Generalization adapter for NATO guideline P1

relations.name: Refine
relations.origin: SysML Refine adapter used in NATO guideline C8
relations.note: Requirement is an external SysML concept; it is an explicit adapter type, not a native UAF stereotype.
